title: Nintendo Switch 2 sales plunge 41% as price hikes and memory crunch bite
summary_full: Sales of Nintendo's flagship Switch 2 plunged in its fiscal second quarter after the Japanese gaming giant rolled out price hikes amid soaring memory costs.
